Notifications.SyncSucceeded.Title: Sync complete
Notifications.SyncSucceeded.Message: Your files are up to date.
Notifications.ProviderConnected.Title: Account connected
Notifications.ProviderConnected.NextStep: Open Providers to choose what to sync.
Notifications.SyncProgress.Title: Sync in progress
Notifications.SyncProgress.NextStep: It continues in the background. Open Activity to follow it.
Notifications.AuthenticationExpiring.Mes: An account sign-in will expire soon.
Notifications.AuthenticationExpiring.Nex: Open Providers and sign in again to keep syncing.
Notifications.ConflictDetected.Title: Conflict found
Notifications.ConflictDetected.Message: A file changed in two places.
Notifications.ConflictDetected.NextStep: Open Conflicts and choose which version to keep.
Notifications.ItemFailed.Title: File not synced
Notifications.ItemFailed.Message: A file could not be synced.
Notifications.ItemFailed.NextStep: CloudSync will retry. Open Activity to see why.
Notifications.DataAtRisk.Title: Sync stopped
Notifications.DataAtRisk.Message: Sync has stopped and recent changes may not be safe.
Notifications.DataAtRisk.NextStep: Open the Dashboard to see what needs doing.
Notifications.AuthenticationExpired.Mess: An account sign-in has expired and syncing for it is paused.
Notifications.AuthenticationExpired.Next: Open Providers and sign in again to resume syncing.
Notifications.InitialCrawlComplete.Title: First scan complete
Notifications.InitialCrawlComplete.Messa: CloudSync has finished listing your selected folders.
Notifications.SyncScopeComplete.Title: Folder scanned
Notifications.SyncScopeComplete.Message: A selected folder has been fully listed.
Notifications.SyncScopeComplete.NextStep: Open Activity to follow the rest.
Notifications.UserActionRequired.Title: Action needed
Notifications.UserActionRequired.Message: A sync job stopped on an error and needs to be started again.
Notifications.UserActionRequired.NextSte: Open Activity to see which job.
